submission.justification: F1 gave the best simulated resolution at 100 GeV. Its best result was 3.169% at 6 mm in the refined scan, against 3.633% for the runner-up F3 at 5 mm and 5.273% for F2 at 4 mm. The scan was coarse, so the optimum for F1 is about 5–6 mm. F1 at 5 mm gave 3.199%, a difference of 0.03 points. The estimated simulation noise is about 0.1 points, so 5 mm and 6 mm cannot be told apart. I chose 6 mm because it had the lowest value, and it was also the best coarse-scan point for F1 (3.248%). The documents were flagged as ambiguous on maintenance, but the review found no support for excluding any material. All three candidates stayed eligible, so F1 is not ruled out on maintenance grounds. A maintenance exclusion is the one thing that could change this choice.
